response.title: A DEEP REINFORCEMENT LEARNING FRAMEWORK FOR FINANCIAL PORTFOLIO MANAGEMENT
response.label_definition: fully exploiting and explicit reward function
data_requirements: stock market data, dataset different from the original paper
response.training_protocol: Ensemble of Identical Independent Evaluators (EIIE) topology, Portfolio-Vector Memory (PVM), Online Stochastic Batch Learning (OSBL) scheme
